commonPrompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: production illustration calendar BACKGROUND, not a screenshot and not a UI mockup.
Input 1 is the theme to redesign; preserve its specific person, action, setting, lighting, painterly illustration style, board material and decorative identity.
Input 2 is ONLY the approved LARGE-BOARD composition reference. Match its layout scale and placement, never borrow its subway setting.
Recompose the scene: retain the meaningful character/action in the top roughly 38% of the tall portrait, and enlarge the theme's calendar board to almost the full canvas width in the lower half. Keep the board front-facing, not tilted, no perspective warp. Board exterior roughly x2%-98%, y39%-84%. Usable date grid roughly x5%-95%, y49%-82%. Above it leave a spacious EMPTY month header and a separate EMPTY weekday strip, using the theme's materials. Below the board continue the painted surroundings to the canvas bottom.
DATE GRID: exactly SEVEN equal-width columns and SIX equal-height rows, 42 EMPTY cells. Thin straight lines only. All rows equal height, all columns equal width; no extra mini-grid or row. Do not shrink the board to leave large side margins. No object, person, decoration, shadow edge, or pointer may obstruct the header or cells. Keep decorations on outer frame.
ABSOLUTELY NO letters, words, numbers, year/month, weekday names, dates, arrows, event markers, photos, polaroids, tape placeholders, status bar, notch, time, wifi, battery, tabs, buttons, phone frame, watermark or explanatory text. Empty material and blank grid only. Dates/photos/UI will be drawn by the app later.
Full-bleed illustration to all 4 edges, same tall portrait ratio as input 2, about 900 x 1752 or proportionally higher resolution. High detail, beautiful texture, no outer whitespace.

results.prompt:

REMOVE every single overlaid UI and calendar content: erase the top time, black notch, wifi/battery icons, header year and month, both month arrows, all weekday letters, ALL date numerals including the circled date, ALL little photographs/polaroids/tape, and the entire floating bottom navigation capsule including icons and words. Seamlessly reconstruct the underlying painted scene/blank cream paper. Keep ONLY the empty decorative month header border, empty weekday space, and blank 7-column by 6-row date grid.
Critical geometry repair: all seven columns equal width; all SIX rows equal height. The entire grid is front-facing, rectangular, horizontal/vertical, no perspective. Maintain the grid bounding rectangle from the reference, approximately x4.5%-95.5%, y49%-82% of the portrait canvas. Header space sits above the grid. Keep calendar board large; do not shrink it. The scenic top occupies roughly 38% and board roughly 45%.
Absolutely NO text/letters/numerals anywhere, NO photographs, NO event circle, NO arrows, NO status bar, NO bottom controls, NO icons, NO watermark. This is a finished usable blank illustration asset. Full bleed to all four edges, same tall portrait ratio as input, high resolution. Do not include any explanatory annotations.
